name: Kono Yo de Mottomo Zankoku na Kiss
original_name: この世で最も残酷なキス
source:
On the way home from school as usual, 
Stopping at a red light as usual, 
Messing with my cell phone as usual.

When the signal changed I started to cross.

At that time, I disappeared.

[Translated from the official site]
translation:
像往常一样放学回家，
像往常一样在红灯前停下，
像往常一样摆弄手机。

信号灯变绿后，我开始过马路。

就在那时，我消失了。

[译自官方网站]
